email.subject: Shoreline Group Dentistry: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I looked at Shoreline Group Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no way to book an appointment online, and the phone number isn't clickable on mobile, so people searching on their phone can't call with one tap. Together those probably send a chunk of visitors straight to a competitor's site instead.

I also noticed the footer still shows an old year/address, which is a smaller fix but worth cleaning up.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change. Worth a quick look?

Alex
